notes.title: Wobblin' Up!
notes.notes:
Salutations!

Three Goblin Wobblin' was chosen to be a part of the Yogscast Games' Tiny Teams event!
Tiny Teams is an amazing festival that celebrates cool games made by tiny developer teams, and we are honored to be a part of it.

To kick off this exciting occasion we are running a 30% discount until August 15th.

Make sure to visit the event page and check out all the other awesome games:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024


That's not all! We are also thrilled to announce we've added a brand new level to our game.

[h2]Presenting: Clamber Tower![/h2]

[previewyoutube=xJ39Xioq9Ss;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xJ39Xioq9Ss[/previewyoutube]
Explore a crumbling tower and uncover its ancient magic secrets!
The usual wizard brew awaits you at the very top. Can you climb the treacherous path along its walls and overcome its confusing elevator configuration?
Whatever you do, make sure to keep your balance on point, as it's a long way up!

A new level also means new pretzels and their corresponding achievements! 
Can you find and collect all 10 of them?

Happy climbin' and keep wobblin'!

notes.title: Update V1.1 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we released an update with the following changes:

Achievements:
[list]
[*] We have added 29 Steam achievements to the game
[*] You can unlock them by completing levels and collecting pretzels
[*] If you've previously done any of those, your achievements should get updated the next time you launch the game
[/list]

Keyboard control remapping:
[list]
[*] You can now customize your keyboard controls in the new Input tab of the Options menu
[/list]

Quality-of-life improvements:
[list]
[*] The game will now pause when a controller is disconnected
[*] The game will now pause when opening Steam Overlay
[*] Audio settings are now applied immediately on change
[*] Moved the QWERTY and AZERTY selection to the Input tab of the Options menu
[*] Fixed Level Editor automatic screenshots created during publishing being pitch black
[/list]

The game is currently on -20% sale which ends on July 11th, so make sure to get it if you haven't already!
Take care of yourselves and each other, and don't forget to tell your friends about the Three Goblin Wobblin'!

notes.title: Three Goblin Wobblin' is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Goblins and other wobbly creatures!

The moment has arrived! [b]Three Goblin Wobblin' is available for everyone to play![/b]
After lots of hard work on new levels and many other features, you can finally help our goblins satisfy their craving for beer! Download the full version now and start wobblin'! Don't forget the pretzels!

Plus, we've got some more awesome news:[b] there's a cool new LEVEL EDITOR in the game![/b]
We can't wait to see what unique challenges the community can come up with for our goblins. Once you create your masterpiece of level design, make sure to share it with others on the Steam Workshop.

We've also added some COSMETIC ITEMS to the game, so you can customize how your goblins look. Right now there are only two unlocked at the start, but if you complete the game you will unlock another special one. Of course, we plan on adding more. These cosmetics will always be completely FREE TO UNLOCK! Old-school style!

That's not all. We have many more ideas we would like to add to the game, so you can expect more levels, items, and obstacles in the future. With that in mind, your feedback matters to us! Don't hesitate to share your suggestions and report any pesky hiccups or bugs you stumble upon. Just give us a shout on the forums.

And remember, a drunk goblin is a happy goblin. We expect countless tumbles, but we know you can persevere!
Good luck, and thank you for being part of our adventure.

Love, Cutting Edge Entertainment

notes.title: Three Goblin Wobblin' on Pixel Pitch!
notes.notes:
Salutations!

As many of you might already be aware, Three Goblin Wobblin' was recently featured in the first episode of OTK's Pixel Pitch! We want to take this opportunity to extend our heartfelt thanks to the organizers and judges for giving us this opportunity to show off our game to a wider audience.

In case you missed the first episode you can watch it here (our pitch starts at 2h 20m 48s):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bEolSoGlGBc&t=8453

A special thank you to all the other participants for their incredible work. Be sure to check out their games as well!

Since both Asmongold and Sodapoppin were such good sports, and helped their goblins complete the tutorial, we will be adding their respective skins to the full game.

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.notes:
Greetings once again, dear goblins and other wobbling creatures.

Firstly, we want to extend a heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you who has played our new demo and wishlisted our game! Your support and feedback mean the world to us.

We were blown away by the spike in wishlists during the Steam Next Fest. It's heartening to know there are so many of you out there excited to help these goblins get their beverage.

We've listened to your awesome feedback and tinkered on some things behind the scenes.
Based on your suggestions, we've decided to introduce a new set of controls that lets you turn your goblins (including the camera) in 90-degree increments, making it easier to navigate through the winding town streets.

Along with the turning, we've added a new mechanic to help ease the frustration of repeatedly failing and having to redo the whole level. It's a new type of shortcut that you'll surely notice right at the start of the Market Town level. However, it's locked by a new type of lock, so to uncover its mystery, you'll have to explore the level to find a key for it. (Hint: It's in the place with all the books.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624687/a0a114c35b7960913111ae1387a22bfb9f195183.png[/img]

You can find these features, along with various small fixes and minor gameplay adjustments, in an update we just released for the demo. Feel free to jump back in, check out the changes, and let us know what you think. 

Once again, thank you for being a part of our journey. Stay tuned for future updates as we forge ahead towards a full release.

Have fun and happy wobblin'!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - New Demo Available!
notes.notes:
Attention, Goblins!

We're super excited to bring you a new playable demo, as part of the Steam Next Fest celebration.
The updated demo has lots of cutting-edge™ features developed just for you!

[h3]Tutorial Level[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624687/df0957ff646a29fd220b76ef81d66bbf1a2e575f.png[/img]
Wobbling can be difficult, so our new demo lets you play through a short obstacle course to learn the ropes and get more comfortable with the controls.

[h3]Market Town[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624687/78af6b9fc59e6db025d1f0f56e0081e6897f7859.png[/img]
Once you get used to the controls, it's time for the main event! Three Goblin Wobblin's first full-fledged level stage! Explore the busy town streets and bustling markets, before ducking into the tavern and going after that coveted hooman ale.

[h3]New Hooman Behavior[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624687/028a8f924fc0ac159ee56a6b47ba6554a13eeb7b.png[/img]
It seems that the hoomans have gotten a bit smarter and more suspicious. They will now try to chase you if you hang around them for too long. Also, it seems this town has guards too. Luckily, they are as clumsy as any other hooman. Regardless, you'll have to be careful when sneaking around and look for ways to improve your disguise. I would say "Stay on your toes!", but that would make wobbling even more difficult.

[h3]New Obstacles, Gadgets and Contraptions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624687/25f661d95064e77564b2a05160347c6d8767ec86.png[/img]
As you explore hooman settlements, you will come across various strange items and contraptions. It seems they decided to protect their beer with various doors and levers. The goblin elders assure me you are the three smartest goblins in the whole village, so I'm sure you can figure it out.

[h3]Collectible Pretzels[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624687/54daa119637fb76585ef66885099a16c93b162a1.png[/img]
A new hooman invention! Each level has several of these pretzels scattered around so you could try collecting them all. They say these go well with hooman beer.

Many more goodies await you in the Demo! So make sure to give it a try! It's free!

Have fun and see you in the tavern!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Goblins and other wobbling creatures!

We've updated the demo with a few new improvements:
 
[list]
[*]There is now a video tutorial popup when you start the game for the first time, showing you how to wobble properly. The same video can also be accessed through the Instructions Menu
[*]Adjusted the game and goblin balancing
[*]You can now find a difficulty selection option in the settings menu
[*]Bumping into objects will now nudge and destabilize you more, so be careful!
[/list]
Wobbling is hard work and requires lots of patience. For the full game we plan to create many new levels, obstacles and challenges, so the difficulty will ramp up more gradually as we introduce these new mechanics.

Right now we are still fine-tuning the core movement to make it more fun and more ... balanced.
We hope that the new tutorial video and the difficulty selection helps you get used to the controls.

We will soon be sharing more information about all the features we have planned for the full release. Until then, let us know if you have any feedback or ideas by leaving a comment on our discussion board. We'd love to hear what you think!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2559860/discussions/0/3874842132563025230/]Discussion Board Feedback Thread[/url]

Thanks for playing the demo.
Stay tuned and happy wobblin'!
